units.source_text: 内大臣心中思忖：“此事少有办法了。

en.t: The Minister of the Left thought to himself, "There is little that can be done about this now.

units.source_text: 还不如妥为安排，成就其事吧。”

en.t: It would be better to arrange matters properly and let it come about."

units.source_text: 然而终觉得于心不快，又想：“先得让夕雾有了稍高的官位，

en.t: Yet he still felt displeased at heart, and thought again, "First I must see to it that Yugiri attains a somewhat higher rank,

units.source_text: 使我们也不致丧失体面。

en.t: so that we too will not lose face.

units.source_text: 然后察看他对云居雁的爱情深浅如何，再作决定。

en.t: Then I will observe how deep his love for Kumoi no Kari is, and decide after that.

units.source_text: 即使允许他们，也得郑重举行婚礼。

en.t: Even if I permit them to be together, the wedding must be carried out with proper solemnity.

units.source_text: 照以前那样让两人住在一起，即使加以劝诫，

en.t: If the two are allowed to live together as before, then even if they are admonished,

units.source_text: 深恐年幼无知之人，会做出不好看的事情来。

en.t: I greatly fear that young and ignorant people may do something unseemly.

units.source_text: 只怕太君是不会制止他们的。”

en.t: I suspect that the old lady will not stop them."

units.source_text: 他就以陪伴弘徽殿女御为理由，向太君邸内及私邸内的人自圆其说，把云居雁接了去。

en.t: He therefore used attendance on the Kokiden Consort as his reason, explained himself to the people in the old lady's residence and in his own mansion, and took Kumoi no Kari away.
